description: This is a FastAPI route definitions file implementing API endpoints for managing responses, including creation, retrieval, deletion, cancellation, and input item listing, following OpenAI Responses API specifications. It handles both background polling via Redis and direct provider pass-through, with special handling for cursor-based chat completions.

classes.name: ResponsePollingHandler
classes.description: Handles polling response state management in Redis, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and cancellation of background responses.

methods.name: responses_api( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create responses, supporting background polling and direct responses, following OpenAI API spec.

methods.name: cursor_chat_completions( request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles cursor endpoint that transforms Responses API input/output to chat completion format for Cursor IDE compatibility.

methods.name: get_response( response_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve responses by ID, supporting polling cache responses and provider pass-through.

methods.name: delete_response( response_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove responses by ID, supporting cache deletion for polling responses and provider API.

methods.name: get_response_input_items( response_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves input items associated with a specific response.

methods.name: cancel_response( response_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to cancel responses, supporting background polling cancellations and provider API.
